newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal July 96-April 97 trade deficit 52 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Nepal July 96-April 97 trade deficit 52 bln rupees.

text.p: Nepal's trade deficit widened to 52 billion rupees in the first nine months of fiscal 1996/97 from 40.3 billion rupees in the same period in 1995/96, Nepal's central bank said on Tuesday.
Nepal's fiscal year begins in mid-July.

The Nepal Rastra Bank said in a statement that exports grew by 16.3 percent to 17 billion rupees and imports increased to 69 billion rupees, up 25.6 percent from the same nine-month period in 1995/96.
